# Fiveable

> > Fiveable is a comprehensive study platform offering AP exam preparation, College Board-aligned study guides, practice tools, and academic resources across subjects from art history to calculus.

Fiveable provides students with study guides, vocabulary glossaries, score calculators, and guided practice for AP courses and standardized tests including the Digital SAT. The platform serves individual students and educational institutions with structured learning resources organized by units and topics.

## Key Topics

- AP Exam Preparation
- College Board
- Study Guides
- Vocabulary & Key Terms
- Score Calculators
- Guided Practice
- Japanese Art History (Jōmon, Yayoi, Kofun, Asuka, Nara periods)
- Buddhism & Buddhist Art
- Test Preparation
- AP Classes Difficulty Rankings
- Digital SAT
- Academic Planning
- Historical Periods
- Exam Rubrics

## AP Exam Tools & Resources

- [Fiveable for Schools](https://fiveable.me/schools): AP study platform for schools/districts with bulk licensing options
- [AP Gov Score Calculator](https://fiveable.me/ap-gov/ap-score-calculator): AP US Government score predictor using official College Board rubrics
- [AP Italian Score Calculator](https://fiveable.me/ap-italian/ap-score-calculator): AP Italian exam score predictor based on College Board rubrics
- [Class Schedule Tracker](https://fiveable.me/class-schedule): AP course tracker and academic planner by school year
- [Hardest AP Classes 2026](https://fiveable.me/hardest-ap-classes): AP class difficulty rankings by pass rates featuring Physics 1, Biology

## Guided Practice & Test Prep

- [Digital SAT Guided Practice](https://fiveable.me/digital-sat/guided-practice): Interactive Digital SAT practice with progress tracking and gap analysis
- [AP Art & Design Guided Practice](https://fiveable.me/ap-art-design/guided-practice): Interactive AP Art & Design practice with progress tracking

## Vocabulary & Key Terms Reference

- [AP Macroeconomics Key Terms](https://fiveable.me/ap-macro/key-terms): AP Macro vocabulary covering GDP, PPC, AD-AS models by unit
- [AP Art History Key Terms](https://fiveable.me/ap-art-history/key-terms): AP Art History vocabulary glossary organized by exam units
- [Biological Anthropology Key Terms](https://fiveable.me/biological-anthropology/key-terms): Vocabulary glossary for Biological Anthropology organized by unit/topic
- [Drawing I Key Terms](https://fiveable.me/drawing-foundations/key-terms): Drawing vocabulary with artists like Dürer, Giacometti, Martin

## Art & Architecture Study Guides

- [Art and Architecture in Japan](https://fiveable.me/art-and-architecture-in-japan): Study guides covering Japanese art history from Jōmon to Nara periods
- [Contemporary Art](https://fiveable.me/contemporary-art): Study guides covering Postmodernism, Pop Art, Minimalism, Conceptual Art

## Mathematics Study Guides

- [Differential Calculus](https://fiveable.me/differential-calculus): Study guides for Differential Calculus covering derivatives, limits, continuity
- [Additive Combinatorics](https://fiveable.me/additive-combinatorics): Number theory study guides covering Roth's, Szemerédi's theorems

## Social Sciences Study Guides

- [Developmental Psychology](https://fiveable.me/developmental-psychology): Study guides on lifespan development including Piaget's theories
- [Anthropology of Food](https://fiveable.me/anthropology-food): Study guides on food anthropology from Paleolithic to Green Revolution
- [Crisis Management](https://fiveable.me/crisis-management): Crisis communication study guides covering SCCT, Image Restoration Theory
- [Comparative Criminal Justice Systems](https://fiveable.me/comparative-criminal-justice-systems): Study guides on global criminal justice systems, policing, courts
- [Bilingualism in History](https://fiveable.me/bilingualism-in-history): Historical linguistics study guides from Mesopotamia to colonial periods
